context: Class debates the multiple sides of a controversial new policy
purpose: Teach: 都道府県/施行/非難/当該/公的/回収/側面/ジャパン

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は、新しく施行された制度について議論しましょう。
lines.en: Today, let's discuss the newly enacted policy.
lines.style: Calm composed teacher opening, polite desu-masu form with measured pacing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 全国の都道府県でルールがバラバラなのって、おかしくないですか？
lines.en: Isn't it weird that the rules differ across every prefecture?
lines.style: Energetic teenage girl questioning, slightly indignant rising intonation throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おれは公的な支援が足りてないって側面が一番気になるけど。
lines.en: Personally, the lack of public support is the aspect that bothers me most.
lines.style: Casual male university student using ore, thoughtful analytical tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど、当該の項目については各都道府県で対応が分かれていますね。
lines.en: I see, regarding that particular item, each prefecture's response is divided.
lines.style: Teacher acknowledging student's point, formal vocabulary with gentle nodding cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ネットでも非難の声がすごくて、製品の回収まで始まったらしいですよ。
lines.en: There's huge criticism online, and apparently product recalls have even started.
lines.style: Teen sharing online gossip excitedly, fast-paced informative delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メイドインジャパンのブランドにも傷がつくよな、こういう問題が続くと。
lines.en: The Made-in-Japan brand takes damage too when problems like this keep happening.
lines.style: Male university student in reflective mode, casual sentence-ending yo-na particle

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: では次回までに、賛成と反対、両方の側面からレポートをまとめてください。
lines.en: Then by next class, please summarize a report from both pro and con perspectives.
lines.style: Teacher closing discussion with homework assignment, authoritative polite instruction
